name: Kraken BTC/USD near-touch depth imbalance
description: For each fresh reconstructed Kraken level-two book, bid and ask base size are summed inside an inclusive five-basis-point band around that book's midpoint. The five-basis-point band is an initial research threshold that requires empirical calibration. The Kraken input is pinned to its top-100-level subscription, so depth measures the observable part of that local book rather than undisclosed deeper venue liquidity. imbalance equals (bid depth minus ask depth) divided by total depth. Ready output requires a complete positive uncrossed Kraken book no more than 10 seconds old and positive observable depth on both sides. This identity is single-venue: it reads only Kraken inputs and is ready whenever the Kraken book is complete, uncrossed, and inside the staleness bound, independently of the other adopted spot venue. The blended `btc.external.*` reading of the same measurement stays the reference layer and continues to require every adopted venue (ADR 0024). Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even.
